title: Bidiagonal Factorization of Banded Recursion Matrices for Mixed-Type Multiple Orthogonal Polynomials
summary: Given a banded matrix $\mathscr{T}_N$ with $p$ subdiagonals and $q$ superdiagonals arising from the Gauss--Borel factorization $\mathscr{M}_N = \mathscr{L}_N^{-1}\mathscr{U}_N^{-1}$ of a moment matrix, this paper constructs explicitly its bidiagonal factorization \[ \mathscr{T}_N = L_1 \cdots L_p\, U_q \cdots U_1. \] Bidiagonal factorizations of this type are central to the study of oscillatory banded matrices and to the spectral Favard theorem for multiple orthogonal polynomials The factorization is obtained via Christoffel transformations of the moment matrix.
